text:
Maya Chen: Starting a thread to plan a Design Partner + Beta program for the Dedicated autoscale features. Goal: recruit 8-12 partners, 6-8 week pilots, capture perf/cost deltas and integration friction. Need owners for outreach, legal SOW, onboarding playbook, and KPIs.

Samir Patel: Sounds good. Target current Dedicated customers only or include high-usage Hosted accounts?

Maya Chen: Prefer Dedicated and Hosted customers likely to convert. Want variety: chat-heavy, embedding/indexing, and low-latency single-request workloads.

Lina Gomez: I can lead SE outreach. Propose three buckets: 1) high-throughput chat, 2) batch embeddings/search, 3) low-latency inference. Aim for at least one partner per bucket.

Omar Ruiz: Sales / AMs can nominate. What incentives are we offering? Discount, credits, roadmap priority?

Maya Chen: Proposal: 25% off Dedicated pricing for pilot duration + up to 20h SE support + early feature toggles and priority feedback. Case study for public-facing partners optional.

Tess Nguyen: Legal: need NDA + a pilot SOW with data handling, telemetry opt-in, rollback and termination clauses. We can reuse beta SOW but must add explicit telemetry and retention terms.

Ana Park: CS: onboarding playbook draft: 1) kickoff & architecture review, 2) integration week, 3) steady-state testing (4-6 weeks), 4) wrap + evaluation. Recommend weekly 30m check-ins and a shared Slack channel for realtime issues.

Lina Gomez: Feedback loop idea: weekly 30m sync + an async feedback doc with a short form: what changed, what regressed, integration effort hours, wishlist items. Tag requests with priority.

Samir Patel: Engineering will provide a small SDK/flag to enable autoscale plus a terraform snippet for infra. Also an events spec for telemetry.

Samir Patel: Telemetry spec (example fields): `request_id`, `model_variant`, `seq_len`, `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`, `latency_ms`, `error_code`, `cost_estimate`. Minimal footprint, opt-in during pilot.

Maya Chen: Outreach DM template (copyable):
```
Hi <Account>,
We're running a limited beta for Redwood Dedicated Autoscale (6-8 weeks). We'll provide 25% pilot pricing and SE support. We'd love to measure cost & latency impact on your workload. Interested?
- Maya
```

Omar Ruiz: I'll ask AMs to send nominations today. Timeline: we want first cohort onboarded within 3 weeks. Is that feasible?

Lina Gomez: SE capacity: we can run ~4 concurrent pilots with a primary + backup SE each. More than that needs triage.

Tess Nguyen: SOW timeline: I can deliver NDA + SOW draft in 4 business days if we reuse the current template. Will include telemetry consent and retention window.

Ana Park: Success metrics proposal: - cost/unit improvement >=15% for embeddings or >=10% for long-chat; - median P95 latency change <= +10%; - integration time <=2 weeks; - partner NPS >=7 at wrap; - <=0.5 critical incidents per partner. Add business outcome: partner willingness to convert or increase commit.

Maya Chen: Agree. Also capture qualitative friction: integration blockers, observability gaps, config UX.

Lina Gomez: I'll build onboarding checklist and the shared feedback doc. Will prep a Slack channel invite template.

Samir Patel: I'll post the SDK snippet and telemetry schema to the doc tomorrow.

Omar Ruiz: AM nomination form sent. Will collate replies by EOD tomorrow and share a shortlist.

Maya Chen: Next steps: Omar collect noms, Tess provide legal drafts, Lina+Ana draft onboarding + feedback form, Samir share SDK/telemetry. I'll schedule a 30m planning sync for Friday. Tag me on blockers. :rocket:
